ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) to 15% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey), with high intensity concentrated at distal margins and in mottled patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottle located on the distal upper-left lobe; significant white pixel density at extreme lateral tips; primary dark mass centrally distributed with sparse white speckling adjacent to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 62 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke plane; notch depth is approximately 18% of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations with variable pixel amplitude; right lobe exhibits roughly 14 distinct peaks with deeper valleys compared to the left lobe, which shows 11 broader, shallower peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve sweeping laterally and superiorly from the water entry point, transitioning to a distinct posterior-facing edge topography.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular white pixel aggregates (rosettes) located at the terminal ends of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, high-contrast linear marks; three parallel diagonal streaks on the left lobe and two horizontal linear disruptions on the trailing edge of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense white scarring at both distal tips; irregular trailing edge profile indicating historical tissue loss/serration wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white 'rake' marks on the lower left quadrant of the fluke surface.
